annotations.title: Search NSW development applications by council, suburb, postcode or lodgement date, newest lodgement first.

description: Search NSW development applications by council, suburb, postcode or lodgement date, newest lodgement first. Returns up to 100 development applications per call with address, status, cost, dwellings, storeys and development types, plus has_more for paging with offset. status, application_type, development_type and min_cost must be combined with council, suburb or postcode. Use get_application for the full record of a result. Costs $0.01 per call, paid via x402 in USDC on Base; clients without x402 support receive the payment requirements as an error result. Failed calls are not charged. Source: NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure (NSW Planning Portal), CC BY 4.0.

application_type.description: Application type, exact match (e.g. Development Application)

council.description: Council name, partial case-insensitive match (see by_council in /summary) (e.g. Parramatta)

min_cost.description: Minimum estimated cost of development in AUD (e.g. 1000000)

suburb.description: Suburb of the primary address, case-insensitive (e.g. ERMINGTON)

name: nsw_da_search_applications

attribution.description: Source attribution; keep it when presenting the data

text.description: Attribution text to show alongside the data

data.description: Result: a list of applications for search and nearby tools, one record or summary object otherwise

meta.description: Paging and query details, e.g. limit, offset, has_more, count
